stimulus: Independence went the war. No nation took place to the battle field to save the country. Our war of liberation be it without struggle. People from all walks of life can achieve in 1971. They joined the birth right of a nation.
guide_solution: Producing sentences from a substitution table to make a text (a) Independence is the birth right of a man. (b) No nation can achieve it without struggle.
